name: Hamish Campbell
bio:
Hamish Campbell's motorsport journey began not on the track, but in the garage. Growing up in rural New South Wales, he spent his youth tinkering with engines and dreaming of racing glory. While his driving aspirations never quite materialized, his mechanical aptitude and organizational skills proved invaluable. He transitioned into team support roles, quickly establishing himself as a highly effective coordinator.

At Praga Racing, Hamish manages the crucial link between the engineering team, the test drivers, and the logistical demands of a rigorous testing schedule. His meticulous approach ensures that all data collected is accurate and actionable, contributing directly to the team's performance improvements. He is particularly known for his ability to identify and resolve potential issues before they escalate, saving the team valuable time and resources. Hamish’s ambition lies in streamlining testing processes and discovering the next generation of top talent.

physical.description: A stocky build with weathered hands and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out notebook filled with meticulously handwritten notes.
Insists on using a specific type of pen for all official documentation.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces when deep in thought.
